text: What is GSE309890 about, and what files can I actually download?

Abstract  
GEO Series GSE309890 contains RNA-Seq expression profiling data for six Escherichia coli K-12 substr. MG1655 samples comparing sertraline-primed adaptive evolution versus controls over 40 days. We retrieved the GEO Series record via NCBI’s GEO API (gds esummary on UID 200309890) and filtered for supplementary file listings. The series title, summary, taxon, experiment type, platform (GPL24659), sample count (6), and FTP directory URL were extracted from the record. One compressed CSV (“GSE309890_FPKMs_allSamples.csv.gz”, 510 KB) is available in the supplementary directory. This file contains processed FPKM expression values for all samples; no other processed matrices are provided. These data are essential for re-analysis of stress-driven rewiring of the pentose phosphate pathway in antibiotic resistance.

I. Introduction  
Background. Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) like sertraline can prime antibiotic-resistant evolution in bacteria. GSE309890 profiles transcriptomic changes in E. coli under sertraline exposure to uncover metabolic mechanisms.  
Literature Review. No PubMed record linked [GEO pubmed_note].  
Knowledge Gap. The series lacked a clear summary of downloadable expression files.  
Objective & Hypothesis. To determine what GSE309890 studies and which data files are available, we expected to find processed expression matrices in GEO’s supplementary FTP directory.

II. Materials and Methods  
Study Design. We used NCBI’s GEO API to retrieve series metadata and list supplementary files.  
Materials. GEO Series record via geo_series tool.  
Procedures.  
1. Call geo_series(accession="GSE309890", list_files=true).  
2. Extract “supplementary_files” from the response.  
Statistical Analysis. Counts from the JSON fields: sample_count=6; supplementary_files length=1.

III. Results  
Data Presentation.  
Table 1: Key metadata for GSE309890 and supplementary files.  

| Field                      | Value                                                                                                                                                       |  
|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|  
| title                      | Antidepressant sertraline biases resistance emergence via stress-driven rewiring of the pentose phosphate pathway: tktA enables metabolic rollback          |  
| taxon                      | Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655                                                                                                                   |  
| experiment_type            | Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing                                                                                                          |  
| platform                   | GPL24659                                                                                                                                                    |  
| sample_count               | 6                                                                                                                                                           |  
| ftp_directory_url          | https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE309nnn/GSE309890/                                                                                                |  
| supplementary_files_count  | 1                                                                                                                                                           |  
| supplementary_file_name    | GSE309890_FPKMs_allSamples.csv.gz                                                                                                                          |  
| supplementary_file_size    | 510K                                                                                                                                                        |  
| supplementary_file_url     | https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE309nnn/GSE309890/suppl/GSE309890_FPKMs_allSamples.csv.gz                                                          |  

Findings. Six samples profiled by RNA-Seq; one supplementary CSV file (FPKM values) available.

IV. Discussion  
Interpretation. The series provides FPKM expression matrices for six samples under sertraline treatment and controls.  
Context. No raw counts or normalized matrices beyond the CSV are available [expression_values].  
Limitations. GEO’s API does not include processed values in metadata; values must be extracted from the supplementary archive.  
Conclusion & Future Directions. GSE309890 data access is limited to one FPKM CSV file. Future steps could include downloading and parsing this file for pathway analysis.

References  
[1] GEO Series record GSE309890. NCBI GEO. https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE309nnn/GSE309890/ (esummary UID 200309890)

Acknowledgments  
NCBI GEO data providers and the GEO FTP service.
